corrected_hook_points.change: Only if Hor+ widens the 3D projection while g_viewport 0x6595E8..F4 stays in 4:3 logical units with unchanged vertical FOV: multiply Pick.x (float at [esp+0x38] just before 0x426BA1, i.e. the pushed pointer) by (4/3)/(W/H). Implement by rewriting the 6-byte `ff 15 30 b6 5e 00` at 0x426BAC into `call thunk; nop`. The thunk scales [arg].x, then jumps to the real pushPick with ecx preserved (thiscall). Alternatively compute the pick from the real, unclamped cursor so the side 3D areas become pickable.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: (3)/(4) 3D picking under Hor+
corrected_hook_points.risks: A global hook on IAT 0x5EB630 is WRONG: five other sites (0x47FF15, 0x480351, 0x499A02, 0x4BA03E, 0x4D667C) do popPick [0x5EB62C] then pushPick to restore the pick stack, which would compound the scaling. Whether scaling is needed depends on the 3D approach (projection vs viewport). Not validated live.

corrected_hook_points.change: While the window is the foreground window and not playing Bink, clip to the screen rect of the 4:3 block. Turn the game's ClipCursor(NULL) (0x402752 in helper 0x402750) into a re-clip only when the window is active, and release the clip on WM_ACTIVATEAPP false. Redundant if the GetCursorPos hook does the edge warp.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: (4) prevents the invisible cursor from drifting into the bars when the stored clamped value equals the new clamped value, in which case SyncSystemCursor skips the warp
corrected_hook_points.risks: Must release on Alt-Tab and focus loss. Conflicts with pointing into the Hor+ side areas.

missing: The fullscreen SyncSystemCursor calls SetCursorPos on every logical position change (0x4283AE-0x4283CD), not only after a clamp. This makes the 'skip if it already maps to the same logical point' rule in the SetCursorPos hook mandatory, not optional; otherwise the cursor snaps to the logical grid every frame and leftward motion jumps.

pushPick (IAT 0x5EB630) has 6 call sites. Five of them are popPick(0x5EB62C)/pushPick save-restore pairs. The proposed IAT-level pick rescale would compound, so any pick-x correction must be patched at the single call 0x426BAC.

Open question answered: the OS cursor is hidden by an unconditional ShowCursor(FALSE) during init at 0x401730, independent of the fullscreen flag, so it stays hidden in a borderless window as long as g_fullscreen=1 (in the windowed path SyncSystemCursor would toggle ShowCursor at the client edge).

Two more consumers of the logical cursor were not listed: 0x428230 (cursor normalised to g_viewport 0..1, 5 callers: 0x57F5A0, 0x57F62F, 0x582058, 0x5821B2, 0x58428A) and 0x4282F0 (cursor times 1/640 and 1/480 from 0x5EBB1C/0x5EBB20, caller 0x4F7618). Both read 0x654AD0/D4 and need no hook, but matter for the Hor+ alignment decision.

MouseHandler swallows (returns 1) every non-0x20A mouse message in the hook-message range while the app is active, including WM_NC* and the middle button. Any wrapper must keep this, or deliberately pass messages through for its own borderless window handling.

The SetWindowsHookExA IAT value is cached in edi at 0x401F3E and also installs WH_KEYBOARD (proc 0x401B30). An IAT wrapper must filter idHook==7 and be in place before the init function 0x401EA0 runs.

PositionMouseCursor has no lower clamp, and GetAtomCursorX/Y zero-extend the 16-bit coordinates. Only SyncSystemCursor (polled) clamps negatives; the hook path never does. Our hook must clamp, and screen-to-logical must use floor division, not truncation.
Use integer math (lx = floorDiv((sx-cx-offX)*480, H); sx = cx+offX+ceilDiv(lx*H, 480)) so the round trip is exact for all heights (900, 1080, 1440, 2160) without float edge cases.

The MouseHandler windowed inside test is inclusive [left,right] with unsigned compares (jb/ja at 0x401CAE-0x401CC2), while SyncSystemCursor uses half-open signed compares. This matters only if the windowed path is used.

title: Window creation, styles, sizing, fullscreen vs /WINDOW, Alt+Tab

analysis.group: Window creation, styles, sizing, fullscreen vs /WINDOW, Alt+Tab
analysis.summary:
RECOMMENDATION: option (b). Keep g_fullscreen=1 (byte 0x603C39, default 01) and stop the display-mode change at the SurRender API boundary. Option (a), forcing windowed mode, is worse.

Why (b) is cheap, proven from the bytes:
- In fullscreen mode Wiz8 already creates the window as WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE (0x90000000) at 0,0 with GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) x GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN) (CreateWizardryWindow 0x425FEF..0x42605B).
- OpenRendererWindow re-applies the same style and size on every (re)open (0x422817..0x42286F).
- The only thing that switches the display mode is the call g_gerd->openWindow(mode) through IAT 0x5EBA68 (sr.dll ?openWindow@srGERD@@QAE?AW4e_error@1@J@Z, 0x1001A1F0).
- In sr.dll, openWindow(long) with mode<0 tail-calls openWindow(void) (0x1001A20E jge / 0x1001A214 call 0x1001A120).
- openWindow(void) sizes the back buffer from GetClientRect(hwnd): srWindow::getWidth/getHeight 0x100459D0/0x10045A00 call [0x10075258] = GetClientRect. It then goes to openWindowInternal with display_mode=-1.
- In srDD_DirectX7.dll the openWindow dispatcher at 0x10008CF0 checks OpenInfo.display_mode. If it is -1, it calls the windowed opener 0x100084E0: SetCooperativeLevel flags 0x808 = DDSCL_NORMAL|FPUPRESERVE, no SetDisplayMode. Otherwise it calls 0x10008900: SetCooperativeLevel 0x913 = EXCLUSIVE|FULLSCREEN|ALLOWREBOOT|FPUPRESERVE, then SetDisplayMode.
- So an IAT hook on 0x5EBA68 that forwards with mode=-1 gives a windowed D3D device whose back buffer is the full-monitor client rect, with no mode switch. Every other g_fullscreen==1 code path stays as it is.

What the fullscreen code paths give for free:
- Mouse uses raw screen coordinates. MouseHandler 0x401D15 stores pt.x straight into gusMouseXPos 0x6F050A. SyncSystemCursor 0x428340 calls GetCursorPos [0x5EB250], clamps to 0..640 / 0..480, then SetCursorPos [0x5EB254]. That clamp is what physically traps the OS cursor in the top-left 640x480 (the 'raw pixels' bug that was observed live). Because the borderless window sits at 0,0, screen coordinates equal client coordinates. Mapping virtual<->screen inside GetCursorPos/SetCursorPos/MouseHandler fixes goal 4 with no other changes.
- VideoResizeWindow does nothing when g_fullscreen=1.
- The window has no thick frame, so WM_SIZING never fires.
- SuspendVideoManager skips GetWindowRect.

Why option (a) (g_fullscreen=0 or /WINDOW) is worse:
- The style is hard-coded in three places:
  - CreateWizardryWindow uses 0x10CE0000 = WS_VISIBLE|WS_CAPTION|WS_SYSMENU|WS_THICKFRAME|WS_MINIMIZEBOX, plus AdjustWindowRect.
  - OpenRendererWindow uses SetWindowLongA(GWL_STYLE, 0x10CE0000) and SetWindowPos to g_window_rect 0x659610.
  - SuspendVideoManager calls GetWindowRect into g_window_rect.
- g_window_rect is computed as a 640x480 rect, and its .top wrongly uses SM_CXSCREEN (push 0 at 0x425F54 and 0x425F86).
- WM_SIZE SIZE_RESTORED triggers a renderer close/reopen (VideoResizeWindow).
- WM_SIZING enforces 4:3 and a 640x480 minimum on the outer rect.
- Every cursor routine adds GetClientRect/ClientToScreen offsets: MouseHandler via VideoGetClientRect 0x427A70, SyncSystemCursor 0x428428, WarpSystemCursor 0x4280C0.
- The cursor is still client pixels clamped to 640x480 (PositionMouseCursor 0x428155..0x42817E), so the mouse would not scale either.
- You would need hooks on SetWindowLongA, SetWindowPos, AdjustWindowRect and CreateWindowExA styles, plus the same mouse remap anyway.

Answers to the specific questions:
- How the renderer gets its size:
  - In windowed mode (and with the proposed hook) the size comes from GetClientRect of the window passed to createContext(ghWindow) at 0x4224D2.
  - 3DVideo.CFG width/height/depth go to 0x603C3C/0x603C40/0x603C44 (defaults 640/480/16). They are used only for getDisplayMode, which is called only in the fullscreen branch.
  - getDisplayMode (sr.dll 0x1001AA60) returns -1 if the triple is not in the device mode list. Wiz8 then calls ShutdownWithErrorBox at 0x42289C. So also hook getDisplayMode (IAT 0x5EBA64) to return 0, so it never fails.
  - openWindowInternal also rejects sizes above the device caps max_back_buffer_width/height (gerd+0x50/+0x54).
- Does the 2D canvas scale to the client size? Inferred yes. 2D and the cursor are drawn as normalized quads (PositionMouseCursor divides by 640/480), so the 640x480 HUD stretches to the whole back buffer. This is consistent with fullscreen at higher 3DVideo.CFG resolutions already working. The 4:3 pillarbox has to be done in the 2D/viewport subsystem.
- Does the mouse scale to the client size? No. In both modes it is unscaled pixels clamped to 640x480.
- WM_SIZING handler (only reachable in windowed mode): WindowProcedure 0x4011E0, case 0x214 at 0x40141D, wParam jump table at 0x40154C.
  - The 480 minimum height is at 0x401452 (bottom edges) and 0x40149A (top edges).
  - The 640 minimum width is at 0x4014AD (left) and 0x4014E9 (right).
  - The aspect math is width = h*640/480 at 0x401468 and height = w*480/640 at 0x4014C1.
  - All of this applies to the outer window rect, not the client.
- WM_SIZE handler (0x40124D):
  - SIZE_RESTORED calls VideoResizeWindow 0x422550.
  - SIZE_MAXIMIZED calls VideoFullScreen(1) 0x422970.
- Alt+Tab, WM_ACTIVATEAPP (0x401361):
  - FALSE: SuspendVideoManager, MoveTimer(1), gfApplicationActive=0, fRestore=1.
  - TRUE, and only when fRestore==1: RestoreVideoManager, RestoreVideoSurfaces 0x4029F0, MoveTimer(8), gfApplicationActive=1.
  - WM_KILLFOCUS (0x401334) and WM_SETFOCUS (0x401316) do the same Suspend/Restore.
  - SuspendVideoManager 0x422050: gerd->closeWindow(0), then ShowWindow(ghWindow, SW_MINIMIZE) at 0x4220A1, then FreeMouseCursor (ClipCursor(NULL)).
  - RestoreVideoManager 0x4220B0: ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE), then, if the window is not open, OpenRendererWindow (which would switch mode again without the hook), OpenIcon, SetFocus.
- Alt-stuck bug: the WH_KEYBOARD hook KeyboardHandler 0x401B30 early-outs to CallNextHookEx when gfApplicationActive (0x6F0630) == 0, and swallows keys (returns 1) when active.
  - Alt-down sets gfAltState (word 0x6F051C) = 4 and gfKeyState[0x12] (0x6F0532) = 1.
  - After Alt+Tab, the Alt-up arrives while the window is inactive or in another window, so it is never seen and gfAltState stays 4.
  - Fix: on WM_ACTIVATEAPP(TRUE) / WM_SETFOCUS, clear 0x6F04EA (shift), 0x6F0508 (ctrl), 0x6F051C (alt) and gfKeyState[0x10..0x12] (0x6F0530..0x6F0532).
  - KeyChange 0x402270 also has an Alt+Tab-up path that calls ShowWindow(ghWindow, 6) itself.
- Fullscreen toggles to neutralise:
  - /WINDOW in ProcessCommandLine calls VideoFullScreen(0) (0x401A51).
  - An in-game key toggle calls VideoFullScreen(!VideoIsFullScreen()) (0x591B03/0x591B0F).
  - WM_SIZE SIZE_MAXIMIZED calls VideoFullScreen(1).
  - Hook VideoFullScreen 0x422970 to always force 1.
- Bink videos ignore g_fullscreen. BeginVideoPresentation 0x423390 closes and deletes the GERD context, then on the game's own IDirectDraw2 (global 0x6596A0) calls SetCooperativeLevel(ghWindow, 0x11 EXCLUSIVE|FULLSCREEN) and SetDisplayMode(640,480,16,0,0), and creates a primary surface. FinishVideoPresentation 0x4234A0 goes back to DDSCL_NORMAL, calls createContext, then tail-jumps to OpenRendererWindow. These need their own hook (goal 1).

Which calls need hooks and which globals can be set directly:
- Hooks needed:
  - sr.dll imports openWindow(J) and getDisplayMode.
  - VideoFullScreen.
  - WindowProcedure entry (or RegisterClassA), for the Alt fix.
  - Mouse: MouseHandler entry plus GetCursorPos/SetCursorPos/ClipCursor IAT.
  - Bink presentation functions.
  - Optional: SetWindowPos/CreateWindowExA IAT, to use the monitor of the window instead of SM_CX/CYSCREEN.
  - Process DPI awareness must be set in DLL init, otherwise SM_CXSCREEN is virtualized.
- Globals you can set directly:
  - g_fullscreen 0x603C39: keep 1.
  - The modifier-key globals.
  - Writing 0x603C3C/40/44 directly is useless: InitializeVideoDevice overwrites them from the cfg just before OpenRendererWindow.

functions.name: CreateWizardryWindow
functions.role: Registers window class 'Wizardry 8' (string at 0x5FF490) and creates ghWindow. Fullscreen: WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE at 0,0,SM_CXSCREEN,SM_CYSCREEN. Windowed: centred 640x480 client rect in g_window_rect, adjusted with AdjustWindowRect(style 0x10CE0000).
functions.key_details: WNDCLASS: style 0x20B, lpfnWndProc read from global 0x6595F8 (stored by InitializeVideoManager at 0x421C27, value = WindowProcedure 0x4011E0), hInstance from 0x654AC4. Calls RegisterClassA [0x5EB268], GetSystemMetrics [0x5EB278], AdjustWindowRect [0x5EB26C] (windowed only), CreateWindowExA [0x5EB270], SetFocus [0x5EB28C]. g_window_rect 0x659610..0x65961C; .top is computed from SM_CXSCREEN (bug, push 0 at 0x425F54/0x425F86). The g_fullscreen test is at 0x425FE4. Fullscreen CreateWindowExA args: ex=0, style 0x90000000, x=0, y=0, w=GSM(0), h=GSM(1). Writes ghWindow 0x6596CC at 0x426064. Caller: 0x421C31 (InitializeVideoManager). cdecl, no args, returns bool in AL.

functions.name: InitializeVideoDevice
functions.role: Reads 3DVideo.CFG (path in buffer 0x603C70, settable with /VIDEOCFG). Lines: device name, width, height, depth, sound provider. Then srInit, srConfig.set for DD_DIRECTX7/6, loadDevice('srDD_'+name), createContext(ghWindow), then OpenRendererWindow.
functions.key_details: Early-out if g_gerd 0x659634 is non-null. atoi results go to g_screen_width 0x603C3C, g_screen_height 0x603C40, g_screen_depth 0x603C44 (defaults 0x280/0x1E0/0x10 in .data at 0x603C3C). sr.dll calls: srInit [0x5EBA74], srConfig::set [0x5EBA78], srGERD::loadDevice [0x5EBA84] (result stored to 0x659634 at 0x42247D), createContext(ghWindow) [0x5EBA8C] at 0x4224D2, then call 0x422800 at 0x4224D8. The OpenRendererWindow return value is ignored here. Caller: 0x421C4F.

functions.name: OpenRendererWindow
functions.role: Applies the window style and size, then opens the SurRender output. Fullscreen: style WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE, SetWindowPos 0,0,SM_CX,SM_CY, getDisplayMode(cfg w,h,d), openWindow(mode) (mode switch). Windowed: style 0x10CE0000, SetWindowPos to g_window_rect, openWindow() (client-rect size).
functions.key_details:
Fullscreen path 0x422811..0x4228CB:
- SetLastError [0x5EB084].
- SetWindowLongA(ghWindow, GWL_STYLE, 0x90000000) [0x5EB274].
- FormatMessageA noise.
- SetWindowPos(ghWindow, 0, 0, 0, GSM(0), GSM(1), 0) [0x5EB23C].
- g_gerd->getDisplayMode(0x603C3C, 0x603C40, 0x603C44) [0x5EBA64]. A result of -1 goes to ShutdownWithErrorBox 0x401920 ('does not support video resolution').
- SetEnvironmentVariableA(FX_GLIDE_NO_SPLASH).
- g_gerd->openWindow(mode) [0x5EBA68].

Windowed path 0x4228CD..0x422941:
- SetWindowLongA(0x10CE0000).
- SetWindowPos(g_window_rect).
- openWindow() [0x5EBA6C].

Error != 0 calls ShutdownWithErrorBox('Could not open video output device'). On success sets g_flush_pending 0x603C3A = 1.

Callers: 0x421CB5, 0x422105 (RestoreVideoManager), 0x4224D8, plus tail-jumps from VideoFullScreen 0x4229A4 and FinishVideoPresentation 0x4234F4.

functions.name: VideoResizeWindow
functions.role: WM_SIZE/SIZE_RESTORED handler. Windowed only: closes the GERD window and reopens it at the new client size, then resets dirty tiles and transient scenes.
functions.key_details: Returns 0 immediately if g_fullscreen != 0, ghWindow == 0, g_gerd == 0 or g_flush_pending == 0. Otherwise: closeWindow(1) [0x5EBA94], openWindow() [0x5EBA6C] (returns 0 if result == 3), sets 0x6596EC/0x6596F0 = 2, clears tile flags 0x652DDC (0x4B0 dwords), purges scenes 0x65964C/0x659654/0x659650/0x659658, InvalidateRegion(0,0,640,480,0) via 0x422D50, sets g_flush_pending = 1. Caller: WindowProcedure 0x401288.

functions.name: VideoFullScreen
functions.role: Sets g_fullscreen from its byte argument. If the window, GERD and an open window exist: closeWindow(1), then tail-jump to OpenRendererWindow.
functions.key_details:
cdecl (byte enabled); the caller pops the arg. Writes 0x603C39 at 0x422974. Callers:
- 0x401277: WM_SIZE SIZE_MAXIMIZED, passes 1.
- 0x401A51: /WINDOW in ProcessCommandLine, passes 0, runs before the window exists.
- 0x591B0F: in-game toggle with !VideoIsFullScreen().
This is the ideal place to pin fullscreen=1.

functions.name: VideoIsFullScreen
functions.role: Returns g_fullscreen (0x603C39).
functions.key_details: Used by MouseHandler at 0x401C83/0x401D0C and by the toggle at 0x591B03. Too small to hook safely (6 bytes, then padding). Keep g_fullscreen=1 instead.

functions.name: SuspendVideoManager
functions.role: Focus-loss handler: pauses the world, closes the GERD window, saves the window rect if windowed, minimizes the window, frees the cursor clip.
functions.key_details: Runs only if g_video_active 0x659710 is set. Calls PauseMainGameWorld 0x56AA30, sets g_flush_pending = 0, closeWindow(0) [0x5EBA94], GetWindowRect(ghWindow, 0x659610) [0x5EB280] only when g_fullscreen == 0, ShowWindow(ghWindow, 6 = SW_MINIMIZE) [0x5EB2A4] at 0x4220A1, then jmp FreeMouseCursor 0x402750. Callers: WindowProcedure 0x40133D (WM_KILLFOCUS) and 0x4013BA (WM_ACTIVATEAPP FALSE).

functions.name: RestoreVideoManager
functions.role: Focus-gain handler: ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE), reopens the renderer through OpenRendererWindow if needed, OpenIcon, SetFocus, invalidates the whole screen.
functions.key_details: Sets g_video_active = 1, ShowWindow(ghWindow, 9) [0x5EB2A4], isWindowOpen [0x5EBAA8], call 0x422800 at 0x422105, OpenIcon [0x5EB288], SetFocus [0x5EB28C]. Ends with InvalidateRegion(0,0,640,480) and sets 0x6596EC/0x6596F0 = 2. Always returns AL = 0 (xor at 0x42223D) except the early 'already active' path. Callers: 0x40131F (WM_SETFOCUS) and 0x40138C (WM_ACTIVATEAPP TRUE). With the openWindow hook this re-open stays windowed: no mode switch on Alt+Tab back.

functions.name: WindowProcedure
functions.role: Main window procedure (stdcall, ret 0x10). Handles the mouse-wheel registered message, WM_SIZE, WM_SIZING, WM_ACTIVATEAPP, WM_SETFOCUS, WM_KILLFOCUS, WM_DESTROY and WM_MOUSEWHEEL. Everything else goes to DefWindowProcA [0x5EB248].
functions.key_details:
If gfIgnoreMessages 0x650DAC is set, every message goes straight to DefWindowProc. The message is masked to 16 bits (andl 0xFFFF). The registered wheel message lives in 0x6F0620. Jump table 0x40152C for msg 1..8:
- WM_CREATE: ret 0.
- WM_DESTROY: 0x401296.
- WM_MOVE: ret 0.
- msg 4: DefWindowProc.
- WM_SIZE: 0x40124D.
- WM_ACTIVATE: DefWindowProc.
- WM_SETFOCUS: 0x401316.
- WM_KILLFOCUS: 0x401334.
Other handlers:
- WM_ACTIVATEAPP (0x1C): 0x401361.
- WM_MOUSEMOVE (0x200): ret 0.
- WM_MOUSEWHEEL (0x20A): QueueEvent(0x800) 0x40150C.
- WM_SIZING (0x214): 0x40141D, wParam jump table at 0x40154C.
WM_ACTIVATEAPP details: fRestore 0x650DB0; the TRUE branch requires wParam == 1 exactly; MoveTimer is 0x420B40. gfApplicationActive 0x6F0630. Calls to VideoInspectorIsEnabled go to 0x4277E0.

functions.name: ProcessCommandLine
functions.role: Tokenizes the command line. /WINDOW calls VideoFullScreen(0); /VIDEOCFG <file> sets the 3DVideo.CFG path; also handles /NOSOUND, /LOAD, /INSPECTOR, etc.
functions.key_details: The /WINDOW compare is _strnicmp(token, 0x5FF4E4, 7) at 0x401A3F..0x401A51. Called from WinMain at 0x4016BC, before the window is created, so it only sets g_fullscreen = 0.

functions.name: KeyboardHandler (WH_KEYBOARD hook proc)
functions.role: Thread keyboard hook. Tracks Shift/Ctrl/Alt state and forwards other keys to KeyChange. Ignores everything while gfApplicationActive == 0, which is the root cause of the stuck Alt.
functions.key_details:
If code < 0 or gfApplicationActive 0x6F0630 == 0: CallNextHookEx(ghKeyboardHook 0x6F04FC) [0x5EB2B4]. Otherwise returns 1 (swallows the key).
Key-up (lParam bit 31) clears:
- shift word 0x6F04EA / gfKeyState[0x10] 0x6F0530,
- ctrl word 0x6F0508 / 0x6F0531,
- alt word 0x6F051C / 0x6F0532.
Key-down sets shift = 1, ctrl = 2, alt = 4, and gfSGPInputReceived 0x650DB9. VK_SNAPSHOT is special-cased. gfKeyState base is inferred to be 0x6F0520.

functions.name: MouseHandler (WH_MOUSE hook proc)
functions.role: Thread mouse hook. Converts MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT.pt (screen coordinates) to game mouse coordinates and queues button events. Fullscreen: raw screen x/y. Windowed: minus the client origin from VideoGetClientRect, and ignores clicks outside the client.
functions.key_details: Reads pt.x/pt.y at 0x401C7D/0x401C80. The windowed branch calls VideoGetClientRect 0x427A70. WM_NCLBUTTONDOWN (0xA1) sets fResizing 0x650DBA. Jump tables 0x401E68/0x401E80 for msgs 0x200..0x205. Writes gusMouseXPos 0x6F050A and gusMouseYPos 0x6F04F8, packs (y<<16)|x into QueueEvent 0x401F90. Button flags: left 0x6F04ED, right 0x6F04E8. ghMouseHook 0x6F050C. Goal-4 hook point: replace pt with a mapped copy before calling the original.

functions.name: KeyChange
functions.role: Non-modifier key press/release to event queue. On a Tab release while gfAltState is set it calls ShowWindow(ghWindow, SW_MINIMIZE) and clears Alt (decomp; the bytes were not fully traced).
functions.key_details: Calls SGPMouseGetPos 0x4284F0 to pack the cursor position into key events. The Alt+Tab minimize path also hits ghWindow, which matters if minimizing should be avoided in borderless mode.

functions.name: SyncSystemCursor
functions.role: Each frame: GetCursorPos. In fullscreen it clamps to 0..640 x 0..480, moves the rendered cursor (PositionMouseCursor) and calls SetCursorPos(clamped), which traps the OS cursor in the top-left 640x480 of the screen. In windowed mode it uses client-relative coordinates and toggles ShowCursor outside the client.
functions.key_details: GetCursorPos [0x5EB250] at 0x42834A; g_fullscreen test at 0x428350. Clamps at 0x42835D..0x428396. PositionMouseCursor 0x428140 at 0x4283B2. SetCursorPos [0x5EB254] at 0x4283CD (fullscreen) and 0x42841B (windowed, after GetClientRect [0x5EB258] / ClientToScreen [0x5EB25C]). Cursor position globals 0x654AD0/0x654AD4. Called by SGPMouseGetPos 0x4284F0 (about 50 callers). Mapping GetCursorPos/SetCursorPos IAT entries makes this work at any resolution.

functions.name: PositionMouseCursor
functions.role: Stores the cursor position clamped to 640x480 and places the cursor quad at x/640, 1-y/480 (normalized).
functions.key_details: Clamp at 0x428155..0x42817E writes 0x654AD0/0x654AD4. This is evidence that the mouse is in 640x480 virtual pixels in both modes and does not scale with the client size.

functions.name: VideoGetClientRect
functions.role: GetClientRect(ghWindow) followed by ClientToScreen on both corners. Used by the windowed path of MouseHandler.
functions.key_details: IAT GetClientRect 0x5EB258, ClientToScreen 0x5EB25C. Irrelevant under option (b).

functions.name: WarpSystemCursor
functions.role: Moves the OS cursor to game coordinates: SetCursorPos(x,y) in fullscreen, client origin + x/y in windowed mode.
functions.key_details: Covered by the SetCursorPos IAT mapping under option (b).

functions.name: BeginVideoPresentation (Bink)
functions.role: Before a Bink movie: closes and deletes the GERD context, puts the game's own IDirectDraw2 into exclusive fullscreen at 640x480x16, creates a primary surface and returns IDirectDrawSurface2*.
functions.key_details: Calls closeWindow(1) [0x5EBA94] and deleteContext [0x5EBA98]. Then on IDirectDraw2 (global 0x6596A0): vtbl+0x50 SetCooperativeLevel(ghWindow, 0x11) at 0x4233C9, vtbl+0x54 SetDisplayMode(640,480,16,0,0) at 0x4233E4, CreateSurface(DDSCAPS_PRIMARYSURFACE) into 0x6596AC, QueryInterface into 0x6596B0 (returned). Mode switch is unconditional, regardless of g_fullscreen. Caller: 0x5AE67E (movie player).

functions.name: FinishVideoPresentation (Bink)
functions.role: After the movie: releases the primary surfaces, SetCooperativeLevel(NULL, DDSCL_NORMAL), createContext(ghWindow), then tail-jumps to OpenRendererWindow.
functions.key_details: Uses vtbl+0x50 with flag 8 at 0x4234DE, createContext [0x5EBA8C], jmp 0x422800 at 0x4234F4. No explicit RestoreDisplayMode call is visible here. Inferred: the mode is restored when cooperative level returns to NORMAL, or by dgVoodoo. Callers: 0x5AE834, 0x5AE84D, 0x5AE94A.

functions.name: sr.dll srGERD::openWindow(long mode)
functions.role: Fullscreen open by display-mode index. When mode < 0 it calls openWindow(void), the windowed path that uses the client rect.
functions.key_details: thiscall, ret 4. The jge/else branch at 0x1001A20E/0x1001A214 calls 0x1001A120. With mode >= 0 it uses device.display_modes[mode] (gerd+0x368, count at +0x36C) and display_mode = mode, which leads to the mode switch in srDD. Wiz8 imports it at IAT 0x5EBA68.

functions.name: sr.dll srGERD::openWindow(void)
functions.role: Windowed open. Back buffer = srWindow::getWidth/getHeight(device.window at gerd+0x374) = client rect. Calls openWindow(w,h) 0x1001A160, which sets display_mode = -1.
functions.key_details: Exact bytes: 56 8b f1 f6 46 28 01 75 07 b8 09 00 00 00 5e c3. Wiz8 imports it at IAT 0x5EBA6C. openWindowInternal 0x1001A290 rejects width/height above the device max back buffer (gerd+0x50/+0x54).

functions.name: sr.dll srGERD::getDisplayMode(w,h,depth)
functions.role: Linear search of the device mode list for the exact (w,h,depth). Returns the index or -1.
functions.key_details: thiscall, ret 0xC. Wiz8 imports it at IAT 0x5EBA64. A -1 result makes OpenRendererWindow abort the game, so hook it to return 0 under option (b).

functions.name: sr.dll srWindow::getWidth
functions.role: Calls GetClientRect(hwnd) and returns its right. getHeight at 0x10045A00 returns bottom.
functions.key_details: Calls [0x10075258] = USER32 GetClientRect in the sr.dll IAT. Confirms the windowed back buffer size = client size.

functions.name: srDD_DirectX7 openWindow dispatcher
functions.role: Driver-level open: saves the window rect (GetWindowRect into this+0x418), then display_mode == -1 calls the windowed opener 0x100084E0, otherwise the fullscreen opener 0x10008900.
functions.key_details:
Decision at 0x10008D2D (cmpl $-1, OpenInfo+8).
- Windowed opener 0x100084E0: SetCooperativeLevel(0x808 NORMAL|FPUPRESERVE) at 0x10008625.
- Fullscreen opener 0x10008900: SetCooperativeLevel(0x913) at 0x10008A3C and IDirectDraw7::SetDisplayMode at 0x10008A85.
The start is inferred to be genuine (SEH prologue), but its first bytes were not read separately: the hex shown is the instruction stream 6a ff 68 e1 09 01 10 64 a1 ...

hook_points.change: thiscall replacement: ignore the mode argument and call the original with mode = -1 (or call openWindow(void) through IAT 0x5EBA6C). sr.dll then sizes the back buffer from GetClientRect(ghWindow) = W x H of the monitor, and srDD_DirectX7 takes the DDSCL_NORMAL windowed path with no SetDisplayMode. Implement as __fastcall(this, edx, mode) and keep ret 4.
hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (borderless at desktop resolution, no mode switch). Also enables 2/3, since the back buffer is full width.
hook_points.risks: dgVoodoo2 settings may force fullscreen or a fixed resolution for windowed DDraw/D3D; check its conf. The device max_back_buffer_width/height (gerd+0x50/+0x54) must be at least the desktop size. VSync and present pacing change in windowed mode. If the IAT is patched after sr.dll is bound, no issue: only Wiz8 calls this export.

hook_points.change: Return 0 (any value other than -1) so OpenRendererWindow never calls ShutdownWithErrorBox when the 3DVideo.CFG width/height/depth is not in the mode list. Optionally write desktop W/H into 0x603C3C/0x603C40 here for consistency (InitializeVideoDevice has already overwritten them by now).
hook_points.risks: Only relevant if the cfg triple is not enumerated. Harmless otherwise.

hook_points.change: Force the argument to 1 (or return without changing anything when it is 0). Blocks /WINDOW (0x401A51), the in-game toggle (0x591B0F) and WM_SIZE SIZE_MAXIMIZED (0x401277) from leaving the fullscreen code paths. Alternative: ignore all calls and keep g_fullscreen 0x603C39 at 1.
hook_points.serves_goal: 1 and 4 (the mouse code relies on fullscreen screen-coordinate semantics)
hook_points.risks: Prologue 8A 44 24 04 A2 39 3C 60 00 (mov al,[esp+4]; mov [0x603C39],al): 9 bytes with an absolute address, which MinHook relocates fine.

hook_points.change:
stdcall wrapper (hwnd,msg,wp,lp).
- On WM_ACTIVATEAPP with wp != 0, and on WM_SETFOCUS: zero words 0x6F04EA (shift), 0x6F0508 (ctrl), 0x6F051C (alt) and bytes 0x6F0530..0x6F0532 (gfKeyState shift/ctrl/alt), optionally the mouse button flags 0x6F04ED/0x6F04E8, then call the original.
- Swallow WM_SIZE with SIZE_MAXIMIZED.
- Optionally swallow WM_SYSCOMMAND SC_MAXIMIZE/SC_KEYMENU.
hook_points.serves_goal: Alt+Tab fix (stuck Alt). Supports goal 1 stability.
hook_points.risks: The game masks msg to 16 bits; pass msg through unchanged. Do not block WM_ACTIVATEAPP/KILLFOCUS, because Suspend/Restore manage D3D device loss. Alternative hook site: RegisterClassA IAT 0x5EB268 (swap lpfnWndProc) or the global 0x6595F8 before CreateWizardryWindow.

hook_points.change: stdcall (code, wParam, MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT* lp): copy *lp, set pt.x = (pt.x - offX)/s and pt.y = (pt.y - monitorTop)/s (where s = H/480 and offX = monitorLeft + (W - 640*s)/2), then call the original with a pointer to the copy.
hook_points.risks: The original also passes lp to CallNextHookEx on pass-through paths; giving it the copy is fine. Clamp the result to 0..639/0..479 or let the game clamp it. Alternative: wrap the proc at SetWindowsHookExA IAT 0x5EB2B8.

hook_points.change: GetCursorPos: return virtual coordinates with the same formula as MouseHandler. SetCursorPos: the inverse, screenX = offX + x*s, screenY = top + y*s. ClipCursor: map the rect, or clip to the 4:3 block. SyncSystemCursor 0x428340 then clamps and re-sets in virtual space correctly, and the OS cursor is confined to the pillarboxed 4:3 area.
hook_points.risks: Every Wiz8 caller is affected, including the windowed paths (not used under option (b)). Do not hook the system-wide API with MinHook unless dgVoodoo/Bink also need it; an IAT patch on Wiz8.exe only is safer.

hook_points.target: SetWindowPos / CreateWindowExA (Wiz8 IAT), plus DPI awareness at DLL init
hook_points.change: When hwnd == ghWindow (0x6596CC), or class == 'Wizardry 8' for CreateWindowExA, replace 0,0,SM_CX,SM_CY with the rect of the target monitor (MonitorFromWindow/GetMonitorInfo). Add SWP_NOZORDER|SWP_FRAMECHANGED as needed. Call SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2), or SetProcessDPIAware, in version.dll init so that GetSystemMetrics and the client rect are physical pixels.
hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (multi-monitor and high-DPI correctness)
hook_points.risks: Optional for a single 100%-DPI primary monitor. Without DPI awareness, Windows virtualizes SM_CXSCREEN and the back buffer is undersized and blurry. dgVoodoo may already declare awareness; verify.

hook_points.change: Replace BeginVideoPresentation: keep the GERD closeWindow/deleteContext, but do not call SetCooperativeLevel(0x11) or SetDisplayMode. Create an offscreen 640x480 16-bit surface (or keep DDSCL_NORMAL and give back a primary surface with a clipper) and return it. Scale-blit to the window each frame (needs a per-frame hook in the movie player near 0x5AE67E..0x5AE94A, or on the BinkCopyToBuffer import 0x5EB2C4). Alternative, lower level: vtable-hook IDirectDraw2 at [0x6596A0] slot +0x50 (SetCooperativeLevel: force DDSCL_NORMAL) and +0x54 (SetDisplayMode: return DD_OK).
hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (no mode switch during Bink videos)
hook_points.risks: With DDSCL_NORMAL the primary surface is the whole desktop, so an unscaled write lands at screen 0,0 at 640x480; scaling needs an extra surface and a Blt. The details belong to the video subsystem. FinishVideoPresentation re-creates the GERD context and calls OpenRendererWindow, so the openWindow hook covers the return path.

hook_points.change: Optional, for borderless comfort: run the original but skip ShowWindow(SW_MINIMIZE). Hook the ShowWindow IAT 0x5EB2A4 and filter (hwnd == ghWindow && cmd == 6) while inside Suspend. Leaves the game visible but paused on Alt+Tab.
hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (UX)
hook_points.risks: The GERD window is closed while suspended, so a stale or black frame stays on screen. Keep the default minimize until the core is working. KeyChange 0x402270 also calls ShowWindow(…,6).

runtime_checks: Option (b) core: bp at Wiz8 0x4228C5 (call [0x5EBA68]). Check ESI = mode index and ECX = g_gerd. Set ESI = -1 by hand and continue: no display-mode change should happen, and the game should render in a WS_POPUP full-monitor window. bp srDD_DirectX7 0x10008D2D confirms display_mode == -1 takes the 0x100084E0 path; a bp on 0x10008A85 (SetDisplayMode) must never hit.
Back buffer size: after the hacked open, call or break in sr.dll ?getWidth@srGERD@@ 0x1001D020 / getHeight 0x1001D0A0 (or bp 0x100459F6 to read GetClientRect's result) and confirm W x H = desktop.
getDisplayMode failure path: set 3DVideo.CFG to a resolution the device does not list, bp 0x42289C (ShutdownWithErrorBox), and confirm the getDisplayMode hook prevents it.

Window style: bp 0x426059 (CreateWindowExA args) and 0x42286F (SetWindowPos). Check style 0x90000000 and size SM_CX/SM_CY. In Spy++-like checks or via GetWindowLong after startup, confirm WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE.

MouseHandler: bp 0x401D15. Check SI (pt.x) is raw screen x in fullscreen. After the hook, SI should be in 0..640.

Alt stuck: bp 0x401C25 (alt key-down store) and 0x401B97 (alt key-up). Do Alt+Tab away and back. The key-up bp should not hit; read word [0x6F051C] == 4 after return. With the WindowProcedure hook it should read 0.

WM_ACTIVATEAPP flow: bp 0x40136A and 0x4013B1. Alt+Tab: confirm FALSE calls 0x422050 (SuspendVideoManager) and ShowWindow(…,6) at 0x4220A1, and TRUE calls 0x4220B0 and then OpenRendererWindow 0x422105. With the openWindow hook, no mode switch should happen on return.

Fullscreen toggles: bp 0x422970. Launch with /WINDOW (hit from 0x401A56 return addr), press the in-game toggle (return 0x591B14) and send WM_SIZE SIZE_MAXIMIZED. Confirm the hook keeps byte [0x603C39] == 1.

Bink: bp 0x4233C9 and 0x4233E4. When the intro movie starts, confirm SetCooperativeLevel(ghWindow, 0x11) and SetDisplayMode(640,480,16) on [0x6596A0], with the monitor mode changing. Then test the vtable/inline replacement.

Windowed-mode reference (option a sanity): launch with /WINDOW, bp 0x40141D on resize. Observe the min-640x480/4:3 math on the outer rect, and VideoResizeWindow 0x422550 reopening the renderer on SIZE_RESTORED.
open_questions: Does dgVoodoo2 (DDraw.dll/D3DImm.dll in the game folder) honour a DDSCL_NORMAL windowed D3D7 device on a WS_POPUP full-monitor window? Or does its config (FullScreenMode/ScalingMode/forced resolution) force fullscreen or rescale? Check dgVoodoo.conf in games\work.

Is device max_back_buffer_width/height (gerd+0x50/+0x54, filled by srDD_DirectX7 at createContext) at least the desktop size (e.g. 2560/3840 wide) under dgVoodoo? If not, openWindowInternal returns ERROR_INVALID_VALUE (0x1001A36C).

Inferred, not traced: the 640x480 2D layer (normalized quads, ortho) stretches to the whole back buffer. This needs confirmation in the 2D/viewport subsystem, where the 4:3 pillarbox and the Hor+ FOV have to be implemented.

Bink: exactly how the movie player (around 0x5AE67E..0x5AE94A) writes frames into the surface returned by BeginVideoPresentation (Lock + BinkCopyToBuffer at fixed 0,0? Blt?), and therefore the best per-frame hook for scaled presentation.
Does anything restore the desktop mode after FinishVideoPresentation? No RestoreDisplayMode call was seen in 0x4234A0; it may rely on DDSCL_NORMAL or dgVoodoo behaviour.

Does sr.dll or srDD_DirectX7 call ChangeDisplaySettings or anything else mode-related elsewhere, e.g. on closeWindow hint 0/1? Not checked; srDD_DirectX7 imports only GetClientRect, GetWindowRect and SetWindowPos from user32.
Did the dispatcher's SetWindowPos (srDD_DirectX7 after 0x10008D56, which restores the saved window rect after a fullscreen open) leave any side effect on the windowed path? Not fully traced.

Windowed path: style 0x10CE0000, SetWindowPos(g_window_rect), openWindow() via [0x5EBA6C].
checks.evidence: 0x422800..0x422968. Fullscreen: 0x422824, 0x42286F, 0x42288F call [0x5EBA64], 0x422897 cmp esi,-1 / jne, 0x42289C push 0x603E94 / call 0x401920, 0x4228C4 push esi / 0x4228C5 call [0x5EBA68]. Windowed: 0x4228E0, 0x422935, 0x422941 call [0x5EBA6C]. Success sets byte 0x603C3A=1 at 0x42295D.

checks.claim: sr.dll openWindow(long) with mode<0 calls openWindow(void), which sizes from srWindow::getWidth/getHeight (GetClientRect) and opens with display_mode=-1
checks.evidence: 0x1001A20E test esi,esi / jge; 0x1001A214 call 0x1001A120. 0x1001A120 calls getHeight 0x10045A00 and getWidth 0x100459D0, then openWindow(JJ) 0x1001A160. That function builds OpenInfo {winW, winH, w, h, mode=-1 (mov $0xffffffff at 0x1001A1D1)} and calls openWindowInternal 0x1001A290. I did not disassemble getWidth's GetClientRect call.

checks.claim: openWindowInternal rejects sizes above gerd+0x50/+0x54 (device max back buffer)
checks.evidence: 0x1001A369 cmp [esi+8],[ebp+0x50] / ja fail; 0x1001A375 cmp [esi+0xC],[ebp+0x54] / ja fail. Also mode must be >= -1 and < count [ebp+0x36C] (0x1001A351..0x1001A363). w<=winW and h<=winH are checked at 0x1001A2C4..0x1001A2DD.

checks.evidence: 0x1001AA60..0x1001AAA3: compares (w,h,depth) against 12-byte entries at [ecx+0x368], count [ecx+0x36C]; or eax,-1; ret 0xC.

checks.claim: Open question: does the dispatcher's SetWindowPos (after 0x10008D56) affect the windowed path?
checks.evidence: 0x10008D52 cmp ebp,edi / je success. The SetWindowPos [0x10011094] at 0x10008D7B runs only when the fullscreen opener returned an error. The windowed branch jumps from 0x10008D44 to 0x10008D81 and skips it. The question is moot.

checks.claim: The windowed opener works on any device and desktop (implied by 'high' confidence)
checks.evidence: 0x100084E0 has extra gates that return error 4. Device-info byte [+0x115] must be non-zero (0x10008509). The desktop bpp from GetDisplayMode (vtbl+0x30) must be 16/24/32 and have the matching capability bit in [devinfo+0x9C] (0x10008554..0x10008585). The desktop pixel format must be found in the device's format list (0x100085D3 loop). Then: primary surface (caps 0x200), clipper SetHWnd(this+0x1EC) (vtbl+0x20), and an offscreen 3D render target of w x h (caps 0x2040). Present is therefore a clipped Blt. Under dgVoodoo the desktop is 32bpp, so the 32-bit capability bit must be set. This is a runtime unknown and was not flagged.

checks.claim: VideoFullScreen 0x422970 writes g_fullscreen from its argument; if the window, GERD and an open window exist it calls closeWindow(1) and tail-jumps to OpenRendererWindow. Callers 0x401277, 0x401A51, 0x591B0F.
checks.evidence: 0x422970 mov al,[esp+4]; 0x422974 mov [0x603C39],al; 0x42299E call [0x5EBA94]; 0x4229A4 jmp 0x422800. Xrefs found in the full disassembly: 0x401277, 0x401A51, 0x591B0F (toggle preceded by call 0x4229B0 at 0x591B03).

The in-game toggle and SIZE_MAXIMIZED would cause a needless renderer close/reopen (a black flash, and possible texture/scene loss). The hook should be a pure no-op that just guarantees [0x603C39]=1.

VideoResizeWindow returns immediately when g_fullscreen!=0
checks.evidence: 0x422550..0x42255A: mov al,[0x603C39]; cmp al,bl(0); jne 0x4227F4. The rest of the body was not traced.

checks.evidence: The only reachable ClipCursor call is ClipCursor(NULL) in FreeMouseCursor 0x402752. checks.evidence: 0x42834A GetCursorPos; 0x428350 g_fullscreen test; clamps 0x42835D..0x428396 (upper bound 0x280/0x1E0 inclusive). If the clamped value equals the stored [0x654AD0]/[0x654AD4], it jumps to 0x4284E2 and skips both PositionMouseCursor and SetCursorPos. corrected_hook_points.target: OpenRendererWindow fullscreen branch: force mode -1 and ignore getDisplayMode failure (alternative to the two IAT hooks)
corrected_hook_points.change: Overwrite at runtime (VirtualProtect) with 83 CE FF EB 14 90 90. That is or esi,-1, then jmp 0x4228AE. Effect: getDisplayMode is still called, but its result is discarded. ESI=-1 is pushed to openWindow(long) at 0x4228C4. sr.dll then calls openWindow(void): back buffer = GetClientRect(ghWindow), and srDD takes the DDSCL_NORMAL windowed path. One 7-byte patch, no calling-convention risk.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (no display-mode switch, back buffer at desktop size); prerequisite for 2/3
corrected_hook_points.risks: Same runtime gates as any windowed open. srDD 0x100084E0 needs device-info [+0x115]!=0, the desktop bpp capability bit, and the desktop pixel format in the device list; openWindowInternal needs W<=gerd+0x50 and H<=gerd+0x54. Any failure returns error 4 / 3, and the game shows 'Could not open video output device'. Verify under dgVoodoo first.

corrected_hook_points.target: sr.dll openWindow(long) via Wiz8 IAT (equivalent alternative to the byte patch)
corrected_hook_points.change: __fastcall(this, edx, long mode) wrapper with ret 4 semantics: call the original with mode=-1. Also hook getDisplayMode [0x5EBA64] (thiscall, ret 0xC) to return 0.
corrected_hook_points.risks: You must not point the slot directly at openWindow(void): that function is ret 0, and the caller at 0x4228C4 expects callee cleanup of 4 bytes. Same dgVoodoo/caps gates as above.

corrected_hook_points.change: Replace with a no-op: write byte [0x603C39]=1 and return, without calling the original. Neutralises /WINDOW (0x401A51), the in-game toggle (0x591B0F) and WM_SIZE SIZE_MAXIMIZED (0x401277), and avoids the needless closeWindow(1) + OpenRendererWindow cycle that forcing arg=1 would still trigger.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: 1, 4 (keeps the fullscreen screen-coordinate mouse semantics)
corrected_hook_points.risks: 9-byte prologue with an absolute address; fine for MinHook. A hand-written 'mov byte [0x603C39],1; ret' patch is also fine.

corrected_hook_points.change: stdcall(int code, WPARAM msg, MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT* lp). Copy *lp and set vx = floor((pt.x - offX)/s), vy = floor((pt.y - monTop)/s), where s=H/480 and offX=monLeft+(W-640*s)/2. CLAMP to 0..639 / 0..479; the fullscreen branch does not clamp (0x401D15 stores the raw word). Call the original with the copy.
corrected_hook_points.risks: Without the clamp, clicks in the pillarbox bars produce negative words. Use exactly the same rounding as the GetCursorPos hook. Alternative installation: wrap the proc at SetWindowsHookExA (IAT 0x5EB2B8, used at 0x401F3E/0x401F58).

corrected_hook_points.change: GetCursorPos: screen to virtual with the same formula as MouseHandler (no clamp needed: SyncSystemCursor clamps 0..640). SetCursorPos(vx,vy): if forward(current real cursor) already equals (vx,vy), do nothing; otherwise SetCursorPos(offX+vx*s+s/2, monTop+vy*s+s/2). This avoids snapping and drift on a non-integer s. Callers: 0x4283CD (SyncSystemCursor), 0x4280D6 (WarpSystemCursor), 0x427B88, 0x427F92, plus windowed-only 0x42812A / 0x42841B.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: 4 (also confines the cursor to the 4:3 block via the game's clamp)
corrected_hook_points.risks: SyncSystemCursor only re-sets when the clamped value changes (0x42839A..0x4283A8). The OS cursor can therefore still drift into the bars or past the edges along one axis. Add your own ClipCursor(4:3 rect) while the window is active, and release it on WM_ACTIVATEAPP(FALSE). ClipCursor mapping is NOT needed: the only live call is ClipCursor(NULL) at 0x402752.

corrected_hook_points.change: stdcall wrapper. On WM_ACTIVATEAPP(wParam==1) and WM_SETFOCUS, before calling the original: zero words 0x6F04EA, 0x6F0508, 0x6F051C and bytes 0x6F0530..0x6F0532 (optionally the button flags 0x6F04ED/0x6F04E8). Also swallow WM_SIZE wParam==SIZE_MAXIMIZED and WM_SYSCOMMAND SC_MAXIMIZE (redundant once VideoFullScreen is a no-op).
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: Alt+Tab stuck-modifier fix; goal 1 stability
corrected_hook_points.risks: Do not block ACTIVATEAPP/KILLFOCUS. Suspend/Restore close and reopen the renderer, and with the 0x422895 patch the reopen stays windowed. WM_SETFOCUS restores without the fRestore check, so clear the keys on both messages. Alternative site: global 0x6595F8 (lpfnWndProc, read at 0x425EC3) or RegisterClassA IAT 0x5EB268.

corrected_hook_points.target: DPI awareness plus monitor rect (CreateWindowExA / SetWindowPos IAT)
corrected_hook_points.change: In DLL init: SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2), falling back to SetProcessDPIAware. Optionally replace 0,0,GSM0,GSM1 with the monitor rect when hwnd==[0x6596CC] (SetWindowPos) or the class is 'Wizardry 8' (CreateWindowExA).
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (high-DPI and multi-monitor correctness)
corrected_hook_points.risks: It must run before 0x425F34 (the first GetSystemMetrics). The version.dll proxy load time satisfies this.

corrected_hook_points.change: Hooking SetCooperativeLevel to force DDSCL_NORMAL and SetDisplayMode to return DD_OK prevents the mode switch. But the primary surface returned to the movie player is then the whole desktop, so frames land unscaled at screen 0,0. A real fix replaces BeginVideoPresentation: return an offscreen 640x480 surface and scale-blit it each frame (the movie loop is at 0x5AE67E..0x5AE85E). Note: returning NULL from Begin (SetDisplayMode failure path 0x4233FE) is a cheap way to see whether the player skips the movie, as a fallback.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (no mode switch during videos)
corrected_hook_points.risks: Belongs to the video subsystem; not traced further. FinishVideoPresentation calls OpenRendererWindow, which the 0x422895 patch keeps windowed.

corrected_hook_points.change: Optional: filter ShowWindow(ghWindow, SW_MINIMIZE) from 0x4220A1 and 0x40237D, so focus loss to a second monitor does not minimize the game.
corrected_hook_points.serves_goal: 1 (UX)
corrected_hook_points.risks: The renderer is closed while suspended, so a stale frame stays visible. Keep the default until the core works.

missing: The srDD_DirectX7 windowed opener 0x100084E0 has extra preconditions that can return error 4 (shown as 'Could not open video output device'): device-info byte [+0x115]!=0; the desktop bpp (16/24/32) capability bit in [devinfo+0x9C]; the desktop pixel format in the device format list. It also calls SetCooperativeLevel with a NULL hwnd (0x10008625), attaches a clipper to the window, renders into an offscreen w x h surface and presents by Blt. This is the main runtime risk of option (b) under dgVoodoo and should be checked first (bp 0x10008587/0x100085E6/0x10008635, which are the error-4 exits).

There is a simpler 7-byte runtime patch at 0x422895 (8B F0 83 FE FF 75 12 -> 83 CE FF EB 14 90 90). It forces mode -1 and bypasses the getDisplayMode failure in one place. No thiscall wrappers are needed.
MouseHandler does not clamp in fullscreen. Mapped coordinates from the pillarbox bars must be clamped by the hook, or the game gets negative or wrapped 16-bit coordinates.

SyncSystemCursor only calls SetCursorPos when the clamped value changes. The OS cursor is not hard-confined, so the patch should add its own ClipCursor to the 4:3 block while active. There is no game ClipCursor with a rect; the other ClipCursor call sites are dead stubs.
The SetCursorPos inverse mapping needs an 'already there' check and centre-of-cell rounding to avoid cursor snapping and feedback drift when s is not an integer.
Two more raw-coordinate SetCursorPos sites, 0x427B88 and 0x427F92 (both followed by SyncSystemCursor), are covered only by the IAT hook.
Forcing VideoFullScreen's argument to 1 still runs closeWindow(1) and OpenRendererWindow on every toggle or maximize. Make the hook a no-op instead.

The game's own IDirectDraw2 (0x6596A0) already sits at DDSCL_NORMAL with a NULL hwnd from startup (0x4260F4), alongside SurRender's own DirectDraw7. Two DDraw objects coexist under dgVoodoo, which is relevant for the Bink path.
BeginVideoPresentation ignores the SetCooperativeLevel result but returns NULL if SetDisplayMode fails (0x4233FE). How the movie player handles NULL is untested and could serve as a fallback.
WM_SETFOCUS restores video without the fRestore check, so Restore can run twice (SETFOCUS and ACTIVATEAPP). RestoreVideoManager's early-out on g_video_active 0x659710 prevents a double reopen.

title: Bink video presentation and display mode switches

analysis.group: Bink video presentation and display mode switches
analysis.summary:
I checked everything below against the real bytes of Wiz8.exe, sr.dll and srDD_DirectX7.dll. I did not modify or run anything.

BeginVideoPresentation (0x423390) does this, in order:
1. If g_gerd (0x659634) is set, it clears g_flush_pending (0x603c3a) and calls srGERD::closeWindow(1) (IAT 0x5eba94), then srGERD::deleteContext (IAT 0x5eba98).
2. It calls IDirectDraw2::SetCooperativeLevel(ghWindow (0x6596cc), 0x11 = DDSCL_EXCLUSIVE|DDSCL_FULLSCREEN) through vtable slot +0x50 on g_direct_draw2 (0x6596a0).
3. It calls IDirectDraw2::SetDisplayMode(640, 480, 16, 0, 0) through slot +0x54. If that fails it returns 0.
4. It calls CreateSurface (slot +0x18) with dwFlags=DDSD_CAPS and caps 0x200 (DDSCAPS_PRIMARYSURFACE), storing the result in 0x6596ac.
5. It calls QueryInterface (IID at 0x5EBBA8, the same IID the 2D sysmem surface uses at 0x4261cf, so IDirectDrawSurface2) into 0x6596b0 and returns that surface.

The call is unconditional: even the original windowed mode switches to exclusive 640x480x16 for intro videos.

FinishVideoPresentation (0x4234a0) releases both video surfaces (0x6596ac and 0x6596b0) and calls SetCooperativeLevel(NULL, 8 = DDSCL_NORMAL). It then calls srGERD::createContext(ghWindow) (IAT 0x5eba8c) and tail-jumps to OpenRendererWindow (0x422800), which reopens the SurRender device. Wiz8 never calls RestoreDisplayMode. The desktop mode comes back as a side effect of leaving exclusive mode (inferred, standard DirectDraw behaviour), and then the srDD fullscreen path sets its own mode again.

Callers (all in IntroScreen):
- Begin: only from 0x5ae67e in IntroScreenEnter (0x5ae510).
- Finish: from 0x5ae834 and 0x5ae84d in AdvanceIntroScreen (0x5ae780), and from 0x5ae94a in IntroScreenLeave (0x5ae940).
- W8BinkVideo::Open: only from 0x5ae69c and 0x5ae827.
So every Bink video, endings included, goes through this one screen. All 7 .bik files on disk are 640x480.

How frames reach the screen:
- IntroScreenFrame (0x5ae6f0) calls W8BinkVideo::UpdateFrame (0x5e3020): BinkWait, then BinkDoFrame, then a copy, then BinkNextFrame.
- If m_target (this+8) is non-null, CopyFrameToTargetSurface (0x5e3100) runs. It locks the exclusive PRIMARY surface directly (IDirectDrawSurface2 Lock +0x64 with DDLOCK_WAIT, Restore +0x6c on DDERR_SURFACELOST), calls BinkCopyToBuffer(bink, lpSurface, lPitch, bink->Height, 0, 0, BinkDDSurfaceType(primary)), then Unlock (+0x80).
- There is no Blt and no Flip. The only Blt is the one-time black color fill in SetTarget (0x5e31e0, via DDBltSurface 0x40f290 with flag 0x400).
- If m_target is null, the fallback CopyFrameToPrimarySurface (0x5e3070) runs. It locks the game's own 640x480 16bpp system-memory 2D surface g_primary_surface (0x6596a8), calls BinkCopyToBuffer(..., 480, 0, 0, 9 = BINKSURFACE555), unlocks, and calls InvalidateRegion (0x422d50) for each Bink dirty rect.
- The 2D surface format is 555: g_pixel_format at 0x603c48 is statically 9, which gives masks 0x7c00/0x3e0/0x1f.
- FlushDirtyTiles (0x425b40) then uploads the dirty 8x8 tiles into the SurRender 2D layer. So the fallback path shows the video through the normal 2D HUD pipeline, and the 4:3 pillarbox scaling would apply to it automatically.

Bug found: the W8BinkVideo constructor (0x5e2f90) zeroes only +0 and +4. It is allocated with plain msvcrt operator new (??2, IAT 0x5eb1bc, no zeroing), and SetTarget(NULL) does not write +8. So returning NULL from Begin alone leaves m_target uninitialized and is crash-prone.

srDD_DirectX7.dll (loads ddraw.dll with LoadLibrary and gets DirectDrawCreateEx/DirectDrawEnumerateExA dynamically) has two device-open methods:
- Fullscreen open at RVA 0x8900:
  - SetCooperativeLevel(focus hwnd taken from a shared memory mapping, 0x80 = SETFOCUSWINDOW).
  - SetCooperativeLevel(hwnd at this+0x1ec, 0x913 = FPUSETUP|SETDEVICEWINDOW|EXCLUSIVE|ALLOWREBOOT|FULLSCREEN).
  - IDirectDraw7::SetDisplayMode(w, h, bpp, 0, 0) at RVA 0x8a85, then a complex flip primary (caps 0x2218, 1 or 2 back buffers).
  - On failure it falls back to SetCooperativeLevel(0, 8).
- Windowed open at RVA 0x84e0 (thiscall, takes w and h, ret 8): SetCooperativeLevel(NULL, 0x808 = NORMAL|FPUSETUP), a primary surface (caps 0x200), a clipper bound to the hwnd, and an offscreen 3D render target of w x h (caps 0x2040). No mode change.

srDD has exactly one SetDisplayMode call and no RestoreDisplayMode. In sr.dll, srGERD::openWindow(long mode) (RVA 0x1a1f0) forwards to the windowed openWindow() (RVA 0x1a120, which uses the window client size) whenever mode < 0. OpenRendererWindow's fullscreen branch calls getDisplayMode, then openWindow(mode) through IAT 0x5eba68. That branch has already set WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE and SetWindowPos(0, 0, SM_CXSCREEN, SM_CYSCREEN).

Minimal plan for goal 1 and video (hooks at entries and imports only):
- (a) Begin: replace it so it returns NULL and touches nothing. The renderer stays open and g_flush_pending stays 1.
- (b) SetTarget, or the constructor: force this+8 = 0 when the argument is NULL.
- (c) Finish: replace it so it returns 1. Optionally first call InvalidateRegion(0,0,640,480,0) or ResetVideoFrameState (0x422b10) to clear the last frame.
- (d) openWindow(long) import (IAT 0x5eba68) or the sr.dll export entry: always pass -1. srDD then takes the windowed, DDSCL_NORMAL path in the already desktop-sized WS_POPUP window. This never switches the display mode and keeps g_fullscreen=1, so other fullscreen-dependent code (mouse handling, VideoResizeWindow's early return) behaves as before.

Videos then play through the 2D layer, which serves goals 1 and 2.

functions.name: BeginVideoPresentation
functions.role: Tears down the SurRender device and switches Wiz8's own IDirectDraw2 to exclusive 640x480x16, then creates and returns an IDirectDrawSurface2 primary for Bink to write into.
functions.key_details: cdecl, no args, returns IDirectDrawSurface2* in eax (0 on failure). Sets byte 0x603c3a=0. Calls closeWindow(1) via [0x5eba94] and deleteContext via [0x5eba98] (thiscall, ecx=[0x659634]). g_direct_draw2=[0x6596a0]: vtbl+0x50 SetCooperativeLevel(hwnd=[0x6596cc], 0x11); vtbl+0x54 SetDisplayMode(0x280,0x1e0,0x10,0,0); vtbl+0x18 CreateSurface(desc: dwSize 0x6c, dwFlags 1, caps 0x200) -> [0x6596ac]; QueryInterface(IID 0x5EBBA8) -> [0x6596b0]. Error path calls NoOp stub 0x4023a0. The 0x6c-byte stack frame holds the DDSURFACEDESC. Only caller: 0x5ae67e.

functions.name: FinishVideoPresentation
functions.role: Releases the video primary surfaces, returns DirectDraw to normal cooperative level, recreates the SurRender context and reopens the renderer window (which in fullscreen sets the configured mode again).
functions.key_details: cdecl, no args, returns uchar (from OpenRendererWindow). Release(+0x08) on [0x6596ac] and [0x6596b0], both zeroed; [0x6596a0]->SetCooperativeLevel(NULL, 8); createContext(hwnd) via [0x5eba8c] with ecx=[0x659634]; then jmp 0x422800. No RestoreDisplayMode. Callers: 0x5ae834, 0x5ae84d (AdvanceIntroScreen), 0x5ae94a (IntroScreenLeave).

functions.name: OpenRendererWindow
functions.role: Applies the window style and opens the SurRender output. Fullscreen: WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE at full screen size, then getDisplayMode plus openWindow(mode). Windowed: overlapped style at g_window_rect, then openWindow().
functions.key_details: Branches on g_fullscreen byte 0x603c39 (static value 1). Fullscreen: SetWindowLongA(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, 0x90000000); SetWindowPos(hwnd, 0, 0, 0, GetSystemMetrics(0), GetSystemMetrics(1), 0) at 0x42286f; mode = getDisplayMode([0x603c3c] w, [0x603c40] h, [0x603c44] bpp) via [0x5eba64]. If mode == -1 it calls the error box 0x401920 and returns 0. Otherwise SetEnvironmentVariableA(FX_GLIDE_NO_SPLASH) and openWindow(mode) via [0x5eba68] at 0x4228c5. Windowed: style 0x10CE0000 and openWindow() via [0x5eba6c] at 0x422941. On success sets 0x603c3a=1. Also reached from the activate/restore handlers at 0x421cb5 and 0x422105 and from Finish's tail jump.

functions.name: W8BinkVideo::ctor
functions.role: Bink wrapper constructor.
functions.key_details: thiscall. Zeroes only +0 (HBINK) and +4. Leaves +8 (m_target, an IDirectDrawSurface2*) uninitialized. Object is 0xc bytes from msvcrt operator new (0x5e1ce0 -> jmp [0x5eb1bc] = ??2@YAPAXI@Z), so the memory is not zeroed.

functions.name: W8BinkVideo::SetTarget
functions.role: Stores the target surface and color-fills it black. Does nothing when the argument is NULL.
functions.key_details: thiscall(this, IDirectDrawSurface2*), ret 4. If arg != 0: this+8 = arg, then DDBltSurface(0x40f290)(arg, 0, 0, 0, 0x400 DDBLT_COLORFILL, &fx with fill 0). If arg == 0, +8 is not written. Caller 0x5ae68a passes Begin's return value.

functions.name: W8BinkVideo::Open
functions.first_bytes_hex: 56 8b f1 e8 b8 78 e2 ff 50 a1 dc b2 5e 00 50 ff
functions.role: Sets Miles as Bink's sound system and opens the .bik file.
functions.key_details: thiscall(path, flags), ret 8. Calls BinkSetSoundSystem([0x5eb2d8]) with BinkOpenMiles [0x5eb2dc] and the driver from 0x40a8a0, then BinkOpen [0x5eb2e0]; the handle goes to this+0. Callers: 0x5ae69c, 0x5ae827.

functions.name: W8BinkVideo::UpdateFrame
functions.role: Per-frame Bink pump: wait, decode, copy to the target or to the 2D surface, advance. Returns 1 when the last frame has been reached.
functions.key_details: thiscall, no args. BinkWait [0x5eb2e8]; BinkDoFrame [0x5eb2e4]. If [this+8] != 0 it calls 0x5e3100 (at 0x5e3046), otherwise 0x5e3070 (at 0x5e304d). Compares bink+0xC (FrameNum) with bink+8 (Frames) - 1, then BinkNextFrame [0x5eb2ec]. Caller: IntroScreenFrame 0x5ae751.

functions.name: W8BinkVideo::CopyFrameToTargetSurface
functions.role: Writes the decoded frame straight into the locked exclusive primary surface at (0,0). No Blt or Flip.
functions.key_details: BinkDDSurfaceType [0x5eb2c0](target). target->Lock(+0x64)(NULL, &desc, DDLOCK_WAIT=1, 0); on 0x887601C2 (DDERR_SURFACELOST) it calls Restore (+0x6c) and retries. BinkCopyToBuffer [0x5eb2c4] at 0x5e319c with (bink, lpSurface, lPitch, bink->Height, 0, 0, surfType). Unlock(+0x80).

functions.name: W8BinkVideo::CopyFrameToPrimarySurface
functions.role: Fallback when there is no target. Copies the frame into the game's 640x480 555 system-memory 2D surface and marks dirty tiles, so the video appears through the normal 2D layer.
functions.key_details: LockPrimarySurface 0x421f70 (locks [0x6596a8]). BinkCopyToBuffer [0x5eb2c4] at 0x5e309e with (bink, ptr, pitch, 0x1e0, 0, 0, 9 = BINKSURFACE555). UnlockPrimarySurface 0x421fb0. BinkGetRects [0x5eb2c8](bink, 0), then for each rect at bink+0x34+16*i, InvalidateRegion 0x422d50(l, t, l+w, t+h, 0) (cdecl, 5 args).

functions.name: IntroScreenEnter
functions.role: Builds the path Data\Flics\Intro\<name>, stops the music, disables the cursor, news a W8BinkVideo into gpVideo (0x69c258), calls SetTarget(BeginVideoPresentation()), then Open.
functions.key_details: Calls 0x48ff00 (StopMusicPlaylist), 0x428010 (DisableCursorScene), 0x5e1ce0 (new 0xc), 0x5e2f90, 0x423390, 0x5e31e0, 0x5e2fe0. Video index global at 0x64d8ac, name table at 0x64d8b0.

functions.name: AdvanceIntroScreen
functions.role: Chains sirtech.bik into Wizardry8.bik on the first run, otherwise ends the presentation (Finish), deletes gpVideo and schedules the next screen.
functions.key_details: Finish at 0x5ae834 and 0x5ae84d. Destructor 0x5e2fa0 does BinkSetVolume 0, BinkPause, Sleep(500), BinkClose. Jump table at 0x5ae91c.

functions.name: IntroScreenLeave
functions.role: Screen-leave cleanup: Finish plus delete when gpVideo is set.
functions.key_details: Calls 0x4234a0 at 0x5ae94a.

functions.name: InitializePrimaryDirectDrawSurface
functions.role: Creates Wiz8's own DirectDraw object (DirectDrawCreate thunk 0x5e22b4), queries IDirectDraw2, sets DDSCL_NORMAL with a NULL hwnd, and creates the 640x480 16bpp system-memory 2D surface.
functions.key_details: [0x65969c] = IDirectDraw, [0x6596a0] = IDirectDraw2 (IID 0x5EBB78), SetCooperativeLevel(0, 8) at 0x4260f4. Surface: flags 0x1007, caps 0x840 (OFFSCREENPLAIN|SYSTEMMEMORY), pixel format RGB 16 with masks from 0x650f4a/4c/4e -> [0x6596a4], then QueryInterface to [0x6596a8]. This is the only IDirectDraw created by Wiz8.exe.

functions.name: Initialize16BitPixelFormatMasks
functions.role: Sets the 16-bit masks from g_pixel_format.

missing: Critical: nothing presents the 2D layer during the intro screen. IntroScreenFrame 0x5ae6f0 never calls the render/present routine 0x426790, the only caller of FlushDirtyTiles (0x4268c2). Uninitialized m_target can be fixed inside the Begin replacement itself, because gpVideo 0x69c258 is stored at 0x5ae661 before Begin runs at 0x5ae67e. One hook fewer.

g_fullscreen 0x603c39 is not constant. SetFullscreen 0x422970 is called with 0 when the command line contains '/WINDOW' (0x401a51, string at 0x5ff4e4) and toggled from the options menu (0x591b0f, after 0x4229b0 reads the current value). The openWindow(-1) plan must also force fullscreen=1 or handle the windowed branch.

Deactivate handler 0x422050 (and 0x421de0 region) closes the renderer and minimizes (ShowWindow 6) on focus loss even in fullscreen. In borderless mode this will minimize the game on alt-tab or second-monitor clicks. That is likely the alt-tab group's concern, but it also hits during videos (0x426790 is gated on 0x659710, so presentation stops while inactive).
IID at 0x5EBBA8 verified as IID_IDirectDrawSurface2 and 0x5EBB78 as IID_IDirectDraw2 (dumped bytes), which closes the analyst's open question.

Frame pacing with the 2D path: UpdateFrame returns early when BinkWait says it is not time yet. Presenting every tick is fine, but the loop then spins at present rate. Consider presenting only when UpdateFrame actually decoded, or rely on vsync.

Bink rect invalidation: dirty rects come from BinkGetRects(bink,0). If Bink reports no rects on some frames, nothing uploads. Optionally InvalidateRegion(0,0,640,480,0) after each copy for robustness.
